pages.text: A Letter of Resignation can be used to leave a Hybrid Network created with a $(l:items/letter_invitation)Letter of Invitation$().
When you leave a hybrid network, any Radiant Storage you placed is removed from the network, and will no longer be visible on a $(l:items/manifest)Manifest$() by members of the network you left.
pages.title: Manifest
Lore
pages.text: $(italics)To my esteemed colleagues of the Eternal University,$(br2)All of my Enlightened existence I have labored tirelessly to bring Enlightenment to all whom the Magistocracy have deemed worthy to share in its light. I have strived to be a beacon of Enlightenment to all, but no longer can I turn a blind eye to the delusions that this University has allowed to fester.$()

$(italics)The Enlightenment that the Grand Architects shared was not meant for the vulgar peasantry. Enlightenment is for the pure; we cannot continue to dilute our ranks with crude Novices who will never become anything more than Journeymen.$(br2)Due to the increase of this practice, despite my many protests, I no longer feel that Enlightenment is truly the highest goal of the Council of Masters.$()
$(italics)I have decided therefore, to resign from this once great fellowship effective immediately.$()$(br2)$(bold)Official Resignation of Master Rashelon$()$(br)...1634, Spring's Birth
